pages.text: Right-click a trigger block with the wrench to enter the c0de dimension. You arrive in front of the program of that trigger block, or of the first free sheet.
On a sheet, the wrench moves and copies lines you marked with the text marker. Left-click a line that is not marked: the marked lines move in front of it. The gaps close by themselves.

Right-click a line to copy the marked lines in front of it. That line and all lines after it move south. In survival mode, the copied blocks come from your inventory.$(br2)Recipe: three iron ingots in a V shape (top left, top right, middle) above a red wool block.
